title: ube-ced: Cumulative Energy Demand of survival goods by Leontief input-output, with the Danish survival-floor model v5
description: Reference implementation of the Leontief cumulative-energy-demand equation (epsilon = e_d (I - A)^-1) for survival goods in primary kWh, and the Universal Basic Energy project's Danish survival-floor model v5. The model sizes a per-person survival basket in primary kWh per year (DK-2023 grid: 6,761 kWh; fossil: 8,024; renewable: 5,920; all PROVISIONAL) from Statistics Denmark input-output tables, a dwelling heat balance and dietary-guideline food quantities, and regenerates its results deterministically from source. Includes the project's canonical-figures and corrections document.
